notes: One admin switch (product_approval_required, ships OFF). ON: a brand's published product waits for INFLX before it is in the store; the admin approves or sends it back with a reason from a new Product Queue. pushed_to_store stays the one live flag, so no shopper / creator / offer reader changes. Four columns on brand_products with approved as the default. Switch OFF releases every waiting product. No OTA. Production-impacting (migration 211 + Render + Vercel); explicit go required before push.

decisions.D2: pushed_to_store stays the only live flag; no reader changes
decisions.D3: four states: approved / pending / rejected / withdrawn
decisions.D4: approval is once per product; edits and re-showing an approved product need no review
decisions.D5: hiding a waiting product withdraws it; showing sends it again
decisions.D6: a sent-back product is re-sent by the brand with Show, after fixing it
decisions.D7: switch OFF releases every waiting product; switch ON touches nothing live
decisions.D8: queue under the Approvals capability, like the Post Queue
decisions.D9: the brand is told by notification on each decision
decisions.D10: reason is required on Send back
